title: Softly Knowledge Learning Path
description: Validates one entry in paths/paths.yaml. A learning path is a curated, ordered sequence of existing atoms — an editorial reading order over the graph, not a new concept. The graph-neutral parts (id, order, steps, illustrationId, status) never localize; only title and summary do.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case, permanent. Never rename.

summary.description: One calm sentence shown on the path card. Localizable.

illustrationId.description: Path hero image id. Optional — falls back to a placeholder.

steps.description: Ordered atom ids. Each must resolve to an existing atom; for a published path, to a published atom (the build enforces this). At least two steps make a path.
